review_notes: Principal family selected from the introduction and Section 4: Table 5’s full-sample prediction of future ROE from current ROE and either BTM (Panel A benchmark) or the BTM bias/lag decomposition (Panel B, Equation 6). This directly tests the stated persistence contrast across forecast horizons. Table 6’s growth interaction is treated as a separate moderator follow-up, Table 7’s terminal-value analysis as a downstream outcome, and Table 3 regressions as validation; these are outside this single principal family.

Equation (4) is retained as a supporting fitted construction because Table 5 Panel B uses its firm effect (BC), lag projection (LC), time effect, and residual. Table 2’s fixed-window N values are not substituted for the unreported N values of the rolling annual component fits used for 1984–88.

The coordinator-supplied reading amendment 002 independently verifies the LC centered-return projection on physical page 12. It is a deterministic projection from Equation (4), not an additional regression. Needs review remains because the source does not name the underlying estimator for the retained regressions.
results_review_notes: The frozen baseline family contains only Table 5 Panel A (BTM benchmark) and Panel B (full components), each estimated separately for forecast horizons 1–5.
Table 5 Panel B horizon 3 prints the current-ROE t-statistic as (.05), while the prose reports t = .5; the table value is preserved and flagged for review.
The paper describes multivariate regression but does not name the estimator. White-adjusted t-statistics are reported, with no degrees of freedom for coefficient tests.
F-statistics under R²(F) in Panel B compare incremental explanatory power of Panel B against Panel A; they are retained in fit notes and not treated as individual parameter inference.

Source-first comparison corrected Table 3 Panel A BC/LC quantiles at 75%, 95%, and 99% to the displayed column values. Table 5 Panel B horizon-3 current-ROE t-statistic conflict (table .05 versus prose .5) is preserved and flagged.
